title: 第155章 成长
slug: 求生游戏请叫我诚信商人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

李知非常感慨：“大家有这样的觉悟，一定都会很快变强！”

距离任务发布还有将近3小时，李知一行人叫上没被对话框和语音提示吵醒的章柏，去了食堂。

工人们已经都等在了这里。

现在刚好是上午9点，两班交班的时刻，刚从船上下来的工人们和准备上工的工人们都聚集在食堂，等待早饭。

看到李知进来，本来吵闹的食堂有一瞬间安静，所有人都站了起来。

等到她坐下了，工人们才安静地坐下。

李知看到已经上桌的炒饭：“这么快？”

贪生paSS：“蛋炒饭本来就很快，要不是饭要现蒸还会更快，你试试看好不好吃。”

李知刚舀起一勺，就见对面的贪生paSS伸长了脖子，一脸期待，不由忍俊不禁。

“又不是你做的，你这么紧张做什么？”

贪生paSS：“虽然不是我做的，但是我加了一点我的小巧思，那个笋你看到了吗？是我和郝师前几天去树林散步的时候挖的，特别鲜美，放在炒饭里应该很好吃。”

李知闻言尝了一口，鲜笋的清香和鸟蛋的鲜嫩在嘴里炸开，伴随着米饭一起咀嚼，确实非常好吃。

她竖起大拇指：“绝对是天赋！”

贪生paSS：“也不是我啦，主要是常玲，这个饭是常玲炒的，我只是提了点意见。”

几人说话时，一个年轻女生端着汤过来了。

她将汤放下，小声道：“老板，这个是蘑菇汤。”

李知这才发现，她就是之前竞选主厨失败的年轻女生，现在看起来比之前沉稳了许多。

“谢谢。”李知问：“还适应吗？”

常玲眼睛亮晶晶的：“适应适应特别适应，老板，我转职成为厨师了，现在已经职业2级了，我每天在这里只要做饭和处理食材就能增长经验，没事还能和大家一起种菜一起聊天，偶尔还能从山里找些有意思的食材出来，要是在外面……我现在都不知道自己还能不能活着。”

说到最后，她的声音已经低落下来。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Li Zhi was very emotional: "If everyone has this kind of awareness, they will definitely become stronger soon!"

There were nearly three hours before the mission was released. Li Zhi and his team called Zhang Bai, who was not awakened by the dialog box and voice prompts, and went to the cafeteria.

The workers are already waiting here.

It is now exactly 9 o'clock in the morning, the time when the two shifts take over. The workers who have just got off the ship and those who are preparing to start work are gathered in the canteen, waiting for breakfast.

Seeing Li Zhi come in, the originally noisy cafeteria was quiet for a moment, and everyone stood up.

When she sat down, the workers sat down quietly.

Li Zhi saw the fried rice that was already on the table: "So soon?"

TanshengpaSS: "Egg fried rice is already very fast, but it would be even faster if the rice wasn't freshly steamed. Give it a try and see if it tastes good."

As soon as Li Zhi scooped up a spoonful, he saw Tan ShengpaSS opposite him stretching his neck with an expectant look on his face, which made him laugh.

"It's not you who did it. Why are you so nervous?"

TanshengpaSS: "Although I didn't make it, I added a little bit of ingenuity to it. Did you see that bamboo shoot? Master Hao and I dug it when we went for a walk in the woods a few days ago. It's very delicious. It should be delicious in fried rice."

Li Zhiwenyan took a bite, and the fragrance of fresh bamboo shoots and the tenderness of bird eggs exploded in his mouth. It was chewed along with the rice. It was indeed very delicious.

She gave a thumbs up: "Absolutely a talent!"

TanshengpaSS: "It's not me, it's mainly Chang Ling. Chang Ling cooked this meal, I just gave some opinions."

While several people were talking, a young girl came over with soup.

She put the soup down and whispered: "Boss, this is mushroom soup."

Only then did Li Zhi realize that she was the young girl who had failed to run for chef, and now she seemed much calmer than before.

"Thank you." Li Zhi asked, "Are you still getting used to it?"

Chang Ling's eyes were bright: "It's very good to adapt to adapt. Boss, I changed my job to become a chef. I am now at level 2. I can gain experience by cooking and handling ingredients here every day. I can grow vegetables and chat with everyone when I have nothing to do. Occasionally, I can find some interesting ingredients from the mountains. If I were outside... I don't know if I can still live."

By the end, her voice had dropped.
